raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This line graph illustrates the F1 score performance of three models—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—across different epochs, with the x-axis representing the number of epochs (ranging from 0 to 18 in increments of 2) and the y-axis showing the F1 score (ranging from 0.55 to 0.90 in increments of 0.05). The lattice model, represented by a red line with square markers, starts at an F1 score of approximately 0.60 at epoch 2 and increases sharply to about 0.82 by epoch 8, remaining stable thereafter. The FLAT model, shown as a blue line with circular markers, begins at approximately 0.80 at epoch 2, rises to around 0.86 by epoch 8, and continues to increase slightly to about 0.88 at epoch 16. The OURS model, depicted by a gold line with triangular markers, starts at approximately 0.83 at epoch 2, increases to about 0.88 by epoch 8, and continues to rise to approximately 0.90 at epoch 16. All three models show an increasing trend in F1 score over the epochs, with the OURS model achieving the highest F1 score at the final epoch.
